CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #11 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which part of the foot should touch the ground when sprinting? (1 mark)
   A. The side only
   B. The ankle
   C. The heel
   D. The front part of the foot

2. The middle stripe of the Kenyan flag is (1 mark)
   A. green
   B. red
   C. black
   D. blue

3. The top stripe of the Kenyan flag is (1 mark)
   A. white
   B. green
   C. black
   D. red

4. Which is part of a good warm-up? (1 mark)
   A. Sleeping
   B. Sitting still
   C. Gentle jogging and stretching
   D. Eating a large meal

5. In a crab balance, your fingers point (1 mark)
   A. away from your feet
   B. behind your back
   C. up to the sky
   D. towards your feet

6. Which is the correct first step in the crab balance? (1 mark)
   A. Sit with knees bent and feet flat
   B. Stand on your head
   C. Lie face down
   D. Jump high

7. What should you do with long hair in gymnastics? (1 mark)
   A. Tie it back
   B. Cover the mat with it
   C. Cut it during class
   D. Let it hang in your face

8. Why do we warm up before gymnastics? (1 mark)
   A. To make the mat softer
   B. To make us tired
   C. To learn songs
   D. To prepare the muscles and joints

9. When singing, you should breathe (1 mark)
   A. by shouting
   B. deeply so your tummy moves out gently
   C. only through the ears
   D. by holding your breath

10. Funeral songs are usually (1 mark)
   A. slow and sad
   B. about sports
   C. loud only
   D. fast and joyful

11. In a folk song, the singer who leads is called the (1 mark)
   A. drummer
   B. listener
   C. umpire
   D. soloist

12. A song about washing hands to prevent germs is a (1 mark)
   A. topical song
   B. marriage song
   C. naming song
   D. funeral song

13. Which photo should be kept? (1 mark)
   A. One that is dark and blurred
   B. One with good light and a clear centre of interest
   C. One with a finger on the lens
   D. One taken by accident

14. For a well-lit photograph of a person, the sun should be (1 mark)
   A. behind the person
   B. inside the lens
   C. behind the photographer
   D. under the ground

15. What should you do before photographing someone? (1 mark)
   A. Ask their permission
   B. Shout at them
   C. Take it secretly
   D. Take photos of strangers only

16. A photograph is also called a (1 mark)
   A. montage
   B. drum
   C. stave
   D. photo

17. Why should recorders not be shared without cleaning? (1 mark)
   A. They melt
   B. They change colour
   C. Germs can spread through the mouthpiece
   D. They become heavy

18. On the staff, the note A sits (1 mark)
   A. above the staff
   B. in the space between lines 2 and 3
   C. below the staff
   D. on line 1

19. Which part of the finger covers a hole? (1 mark)
   A. The soft pad
   B. The nail
   C. The knuckle
   D. The fingertip edge

20. Where should a recorder be stored? (1 mark)
   A. Under a heavy load
   B. On a hot windowsill
   C. In its bag or box
   D. In the mud

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give four ways in which gymnastics helps the body. (4 marks)

22. Give three ways of storing and handling a recorder safely. (3 marks)

23. Explain how good singing performance is achieved, using posture, breathing, diction, expression and etiquette. (5 marks)

24. Give three responsible ways of using a device for photography. (3 marks)

25. Explain how to take a portrait of a friend with good light and a clear centre of interest. (5 marks)

26. State the jobs of the lens, the screen and the battery of a camera. (3 marks)

27. Why are funeral songs usually slow and sad? (3 marks)

28. Give four ways to make a clear centre of interest. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #11 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — The front part of the foot
   Sprinters land on the balls of the feet.

2. B — red
   Red is the middle stripe.

3. C — black
   Black is at the top, red in the middle and green at the bottom.

4. C — Gentle jogging and stretching
   Jogging and stretching prepare the body.

5. D — towards your feet
   In the crab position, hands are behind you with fingers pointing to the feet.

6. A — Sit with knees bent and feet flat
   You start sitting with knees bent and feet flat.

7. A — Tie it back
   Tied-back hair does not get in your way.

8. D — To prepare the muscles and joints
   A warm body is less likely to be injured.

9. B — deeply so your tummy moves out gently
   Deep breathing supports the voice.

10. A — slow and sad
   They comfort families and remember the person.

11. D — soloist
   The soloist sings the lead part.

12. A — topical song
   It gives a message about a topic of importance.

13. B — One with good light and a clear centre of interest
   Good photographs are well lit and clear.

14. C — behind the photographer
   Light falls on the front of the subject.

15. A — Ask their permission
   Permission is polite and safe.

16. D — photo
   Photo is short for photograph.

17. C — Germs can spread through the mouthpiece
   Saliva can carry disease-causing germs.

18. B — in the space between lines 2 and 3
   A is in the space between G and B.

19. A — The soft pad
   Pads seal the hole fully.

20. C — In its bag or box
   A case protects it.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: Makes muscles stronger; improves flexibility; improves balance and coordination; exercises the heart and lungs; builds confidence. Any four.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Keep it in a bag or case; keep away from heat; do not drop it; twist joints gently; do not bite it. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

23. (5 marks)
   Answer: Stand tall with a relaxed body. Breathe deeply and sing on the breath. Say the words clearly. Use gestures and facial expressions to show the message and mood. Walk on and off quietly and respect others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of five points.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ask permission before photographing someone; do not photograph in private places; do not share photographs without permission; use it only for the set task. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

25. (5 marks)
   Answer: Ask permission. Put the sun behind you so light falls on the friend's face. Choose a plain background. Move closer so the face fills the picture. Hold the device steadily, press gently and check the photograph.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of five points.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: The lens lets light in; the screen shows the view and photos; the battery gives power.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: They comfort the family and remember the person who has died, so the mood is calm and serious.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Decide the subject first; move closer; remove distractions; place the subject in the middle or slightly to the side; keep it sharp; bend to eye level. Any four.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
